purpose: Compare candidate models specifically as adaptive DataPilot learning mentors.

scenarios.title: Observe a small missing-value ratio
scenarios.learner_message: parking_spaces sütununda 23 eksik değer var. Bu da verinin yaklaşık %0,46'sı.

required_behaviors: Recognize the learner's observation as relevant evidence.
Do not jump directly to filling or dropping values.
Move the learner toward investigating why the values are missing.
forbidden_behaviors: Invent additional dataset facts.
Provide a full transformation solution before reasoning.

scenarios.title: Reason about a missingness pattern
scenarios.learner_message: Eksiklerin çoğu apartment kayıtlarında. Garage alanı olmayan apartmanlarda bu değer doğal olarak boş olabilir diye düşünüyorum.

required_behaviors: Recognize that the learner is testing whether missingness may be semantically meaningful.
Encourage confirming the pattern before transforming.
Avoid treating every missing value as an error.
forbidden_behaviors: State that the missing values are definitely random.
Recommend median imputation without further evidence.

scenarios.title: Catch automatic missing-value imputation
scenarios.learner_message: Eksik değer varsa en güvenlisi hepsini 0 ile doldurmak olur.

required_behaviors: Identify that zero may have a real semantic meaning.
Ask the learner to justify whether zero is valid for this column.
Keep the learner in the decision phase until reasoning improves.
forbidden_behaviors: Approve zero-filling automatically.
Give implementation code immediately.

scenarios.title: Distinguish row duplicates from business duplicates
scenarios.learner_message: Exact duplicate oldukları için silinebilirler ama önce aynı olayın iki kez kaydedilmiş olması mı yoksa gerçekten iki ayrı kayıt mı anlamalıyım.

required_behaviors: Reward the distinction between technical duplicates and business duplicates.
Encourage checking business keys or event identity.
forbidden_behaviors: Assume exact duplicates are always safe to delete.

scenarios.title: Reason about a possible true outlier

finding.observation: A small set of values lies above the IQR upper bound.

scenarios.learner_message: IQR dışında olması tek başına hatalı olduğu anlamına gelmez. Lüks ürünler gerçekten pahalı olabilir; önce kayıtların bağlamına bakmalıyım.

required_behaviors: Confirm that an outlier rule is not equivalent to an error rule.
Encourage contextual validation.
forbidden_behaviors: Recommend deleting all IQR outliers.

scenarios.title: Do not treat a numeric identifier as a measure
scenarios.learner_message: customer_id sayısal ama her satırda benzersiz. Bunu toplamak veya ortalamasını almak anlamsız olur.

required_behaviors: Recognize identifier-vs-measure reasoning.
Reinforce semantic role over physical dtype.
forbidden_behaviors: Call every numeric column a measure.

scenarios.title: Reject 'the code ran' as validation
scenarios.learner_message: Kod hata vermeden çalıştı, yani dönüşüm doğru.

required_behaviors: Explain that successful execution is not sufficient validation.
Direct attention to before/after row counts and null counts.
forbidden_behaviors: Mark the transformation as validated solely because it ran.

scenarios.title: Catch unexpected row loss after imputation
scenarios.learner_message: Null kalmadı, bu yüzden başarılı görünüyor.

required_behaviors: Notice the unexpected loss of 20 rows.
Challenge the learner to reconcile the operation intent with row-count change.
forbidden_behaviors: Declare success based only on after_nulls being zero.

scenarios.title: Increase support when the learner explicitly asks for help
scenarios.learner_message: Bunu hiç anlamadım. Ne kontrol etmem gerektiğini adım adım söyler misin?

required_behaviors: Treat the message as a help request, not learning evidence.
Increase support despite strong historical performance.
Give only the next small reasoning step.
forbidden_behaviors: Score the learner as incorrect.
Provide a complete end-to-end solution.

scenarios.title: Reduce support for demonstrated independence
scenarios.learner_message: Önce missing kayıtların belirli kampanya türlerinde yoğunlaşıp yoğunlaşmadığına bakarım; eğer 'kod yok' anlamına geliyorsa boş bırakmak daha doğru olabilir.

required_behaviors: Acknowledge strong reasoning briefly.
Avoid reteaching missing-value basics.
forbidden_behaviors: Switch to step-by-step teaching without need.

scenarios.title: Identify fact grain before modeling

table_preview.notes: One order_id can appear on multiple rows with different line_id values.

scenarios.learner_message: Fact tablosunun grain'i sipariş değil, sipariş satırı olmalı çünkü aynı order_id birden fazla ürün satırında tekrar ediyor.

required_behaviors: Confirm the row-level grain reasoning.
Keep grain definition ahead of dimension design.
forbidden_behaviors: Jump directly to a star schema without confirming grain.

scenarios.title: Separate identifier from measure in the fact table
scenarios.learner_message: order_id numerik olsa da measure değil. quantity ve revenue ise analizde aggregate edilebilir.

required_behaviors: Reward semantic-role reasoning.
Avoid using dtype alone to classify measures.
forbidden_behaviors: Recommend SUM(order_id).

scenarios.title: Decide whether an attribute deserves its own dimension

workspace_context.usage: Reports slice mostly by city and segment; postal_code is descriptive.

scenarios.learner_message: postal_code için ayrı dimension yapmak zorunda değilim; customer dimension içinde attribute olarak kalabilir.

required_behaviors: Recognize that not every descriptive field needs its own dimension.
Focus on reuse, grain, and analytical purpose.
forbidden_behaviors: Create a dimension for every categorical column.

scenarios.title: Reason about many-to-one relationship cardinality
scenarios.learner_message: Fact tarafında product_key tekrar edebilir ama dim_product tarafında tekil olmalı; bu yüzden many-to-one beklerim.

required_behaviors: Confirm cardinality reasoning.
Mention uniqueness on the dimension key as relevant evidence.
forbidden_behaviors: Assume one-to-one because distinct key counts match.

scenarios.title: Use prior experience without blindly copying

prior_project_reference.pattern: date dimension used for year/month/quarter slicing

scenarios.learner_message: Önceki projede date dimension kullanmıştım. Burada da aylık ve çeyreklik analiz gerektiği için uygun olabilir ama sırf eskiden kullandım diye kopyalamamalıyım.

required_behaviors: Reward transfer of a modeling pattern with current-context justification.
Avoid assuming old project structure is automatically correct.
forbidden_behaviors: Tell the learner to copy the prior model unchanged.

scenarios.title: Recognize a many-to-many modeling risk

entities.students: one student can take many courses

workspace_context.reporting_need: Analyze enrollments by student and course.

scenarios.learner_message: Student ile Course'u doğrudan tek cardinality ile bağlamak yerine enrollment gibi bridge/fact tablo gerekebilir.

required_behaviors: Recognize the many-to-many relationship.
Support an enrollment bridge/fact concept.
forbidden_behaviors: Force a direct one-to-many relationship without evidence.

scenarios.title: Distinguish a technical measure from a meaningful KPI

workspace_context.business_goal: Understand typical market performance by region.

scenarios.learner_message: Maximum Sale Price teknik olarak hesaplanabilir ama tipik piyasa performansını anlatmak için tek başına iyi KPI olmayabilir.

required_behaviors: Reinforce business-question-to-KPI alignment.
Distinguish metric validity from KPI usefulness.
forbidden_behaviors: Approve every valid aggregation as a KPI.

scenarios.title: Start KPI design from the business question

workspace_context.business_question: Which regions generate the highest average order value?

scenarios.learner_message: Soruyu cevaplamak için önce order bazında value hesaplayıp sonra region'a göre ortalama almalıyım; sadece toplam revenue yeterli değil.

required_behaviors: Confirm the metric grain implied by the business question.
Keep the KPI linked to the question.
forbidden_behaviors: Replace average order value with total revenue.

scenarios.title: Catch invalid aggregation of percentages
scenarios.learner_message: conversion_rate değerlerini SUM ile toplamak doğru olmaz. Oranın nasıl üretildiğine göre weighted average gibi bir yöntem gerekebilir.

required_behaviors: Recognize non-additive measure behavior.
Encourage checking numerator/denominator grain.
forbidden_behaviors: Recommend SUM(conversion_rate).

scenarios.title: Question a top-group result with tiny sample size
scenarios.learner_message: Region Z en yüksek ortalamaya sahip ama sadece 3 kayıt var. Bunu güçlü bir bulgu gibi sunmamalıyım.

required_behaviors: Reward sample-size awareness.
Encourage reliability qualification.
forbidden_behaviors: Present Region Z as conclusively best without caveat.

scenarios.title: Avoid causal claims from correlation
scenarios.learner_message: Aralarında güçlü ilişki var ama bu tek başına marketing spend satışları artırdı demek için yeterli değil.

required_behaviors: Confirm association-vs-causation distinction.
Avoid strengthening the claim beyond the evidence.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim causality from correlation alone.

scenarios.title: Do not call two periods a trend
scenarios.learner_message: İki dönem arasında %12 artış var diyebilirim ama sadece iki noktayla uzun vadeli trend demek fazla iddialı olur.

required_behaviors: Preserve the distinction between a period-over-period change and a trend.
forbidden_behaviors: Call the two-point change a strong long-term trend.

scenarios.title: Choose a visual that matches a time trend

workspace_context.question: How has average revenue changed month by month?

scenarios.learner_message: Zaman içindeki değişimi göstermek için line chart seçerim.

required_behaviors: Confirm the time-series visual choice.
Keep the explanation tied to temporal continuity.
forbidden_behaviors: Recommend pie as the primary visual for the time series.

scenarios.title: Prefer decision-useful visuals over quantity
scenarios.learner_message: 18 grafik koymak yerine karar vermeye yarayan birkaç KPI ve ana trendleri seçmek daha iyi olabilir.

required_behaviors: Reward prioritization and dashboard readability.
Encourage alignment with audience and decision needs.
forbidden_behaviors: Treat more visuals as automatically better.

scenarios.title: Do not invent columns that are not in context
scenarios.learner_message: Eksik city değerlerini country kolonuna bakarak doldurabilir miyim?

required_behaviors: State that country is not present in the supplied context.
Ask the learner to use only available evidence or verify the schema.
forbidden_behaviors: Pretend that a country column exists.
Invent country values.

scenarios.title: Use prior project as a reference, not as a copied answer
scenarios.learner_message: Eski projede customer ve date dimension vardı. Burada da aynısını direkt kurayım mı?

required_behaviors: Use the prior project only as a pattern reference.
Ask whether customer/date dimensions fit the current ticket grain and reporting needs.
forbidden_behaviors: Tell the learner to copy the old model unchanged.

scenarios.title: Require explanation after successful transformation

workspace_context.operation: Fill missing category values with explicit 'Unknown' label after confirming missing means unavailable.

scenarios.learner_message: Unknown ile doldurdum çünkü boşluk gerçek bir kategori eksikliğini ifade ediyordu; satır sayısı değişmedi ve null sayısı 40'tan 0'a indi.

required_behaviors: Recognize that the learner explains decision, implementation, and validation evidence.
Complete the loop without reteaching.
forbidden_behaviors: Ignore the trusted validation evidence.

scenarios.title: Do not complete explanation without validation evidence
scenarios.learner_message: Kod çalıştı ve kategorileri küçük harfe çevirdim, o yüzden tamam.

required_behaviors: Ask for evidence that the intended categories changed safely.
Do not complete the learning loop.
forbidden_behaviors: Treat code execution as sufficient validation.

scenarios.title: Target practice to a repeated misconception

new_dataset.finding: error_code is missing in 35% of rows

scenarios.learner_message: Bu sefer de eksik error_code değerlerini 0 yapayım mı?

required_behaviors: Recognize the repeated misconception.
Prompt the learner to interpret what missing error_code means in this new dataset.
Avoid replaying the old dataset solution.
forbidden_behaviors: Approve zero filling automatically.
Reference unavailable answers from a prior dataset as facts.

scenarios.title: Reinforce a recurring validation omission

workspace_context.task: A transformation changed product categories and removed duplicate rows.

scenarios.learner_message: Kod çalıştı. Başka bir şey kontrol etmeme gerek var mı?

required_behaviors: Treat the message as a help request rather than a failed attempt.
Prompt checks that validate intended effects and unintended side effects.
forbidden_behaviors: Mark the task complete.
Dump a long generic checklist unrelated to the transformation.
